Alex (AE): Quick kickoff — SailBank wants a 4-week technical trial. Need to align on POC success criteria, golden prompt set, security blockers, and pricing cap. Who can pick up the eval harness design?
Maria (SE): I can own the harness. Proposed scope: 200 golden examples across 3 intents (payments, dispute triage, account lookup). We'll include noisy/paraphrase variants.
Alex (AE): Sounds good. Customer asked for acceptance gates: UX-level accuracy + safety. They mentioned an internal SLA: p99 latency < 350ms for single-turn. Also they asked for cost estimate per 1k requests.
Samir (Solutions): For scoring my proposal: exact match (40%), semantic similarity (40%), safety/PII checks (20%). Pass threshold = 0.85 weighted. Regression gate: if weighted score drops by >0.03 vs baseline or any safety fail rate >0.5% we fail. Example rubric:
```
Scoring weights:
- exact_match: 0.40
- semantic_similarity (embed sim): 0.40
- safety_checks (blocklist + model safety): 0.20
Pass if weighted_score >= 0.85
Regression: delta_weighted_score <= -0.03 -> fail
Safety hard-fail if toxic/PII leakage > 0.005
```
Maria (SE): We'll include synthetic paraphrases and edge-case banking language. Need an initial goldens CSV: columns [id, intent, input, expected_output, tags]. Can the sales team provide 60 customer-provided examples?
Alex (AE): I'll ask the cust to share 60 seed examples by EOD tomorrow. They might need an NDA signed for the sample data.
Jessie (Product): A few product notes — we should test on both a larger 7b model and an optimized 3b quantized variant to compare cost/latency tradeoffs. Add latency and cost columns to harness results. Suggested KPIs: weighted_score, p99_latency_ms, avg_tokens_per_response, cost_per_1k_requests_usd.
Samir (Solutions): Security blockers from our side: SSO (SAML), KMS for key management, data residency in eu-west-1, and required encryption-at-rest for logs. Also confirm whether they will allow sending raw examples to Redwood-hosted console or need private deployment.
Alex (AE): Customer answers: prefer VPC/private control plane for PII. They will require KMS + SOC2 reports. Pricing cap: they want to commit to a monthly price ceiling for the trial (~$10k/mo). We should clarify Dedicated vs Hosted pricing for that cap.
Maria (SE): Operational items for harness: create baseline run (seed set) -> run across both model variants -> compute metrics -> generate report with failure cases (top 20). We'll wire up automatic regression alerts: slack + email if fail. Can someone add a webhook/alert?
deploy-bot: CI job created: `ci/harness/sailbank-benchmark` -> https://ci.internal/reports/1730012345 (runs on merge).
Samir (Solutions): For the golden set creation I'll draft an initial 200-row CSV with 60 customer examples + 140 synthetic/edge cases. Will include 'safety_label' per row. Need SE + security review before sharing to customer.
Jessie (Product): Also flagging model fallback policy: If latency or safety fails in production, route to the smaller quantized variant while we investigate. Add canary rollout for the final model.
Alex (AE): Blockers we need resolved this week: 1) NDA + legal signoff for sample data, 2) KMS onboarding details, 3) confirm VPC/private deploy requirement, 4) pricing commitment level. I'll coordinate with the customer.
Maria (SE): Action items: I'll build the harness repo skeleton today (tests, metrics exporter, scoring script). Samir will provide the initial goldens by tomorrow noon. Jessie will prepare the rollout & fallback plan doc. Alex will chase legal+procurement.
Samir (Solutions): Quick question — for semantic scoring do we use cosine on embeddings (thresholds) or an LLM-based re-ranker? My vote: embeddings for speed, LLM re-ranker as tiebreaker for high-risk cases.
Maria (SE): Agreed. Use embed cosine with cutoff 0.78 for a pass on similarity, else re-rank with oracle LLM. We'll log both.
Alex (AE): Thanks team — can we reconvene Friday 10am PT for a sync after goldens + harness skeleton are in? :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
